en.s: On 24 January AD 41, following Caligula’s assassination in Rome, the Praetorian Guard proclaimed Claudius emperor and took him to its camp for protection. Rome is in present-day Italy.

zh.t: 禁卫军拥立克劳狄乌斯为皇帝
zh.s: 公元41年1月24日，卡利古拉在罗马遇刺后，禁卫军拥立克劳狄乌斯为皇帝，并将他带到军营保护起来。罗马位于今意大利境内。

en.s: On 24 January AD 41, the Roman emperor Caligula was assassinated in Rome by conspirators including the Praetorian tribunes Cassius Chaerea and Cornelius Sabinus. Rome is in present-day Italy.

zh.s: 公元41年1月24日，罗马皇帝卡利古拉在罗马遇刺，参与者包括禁卫军军官卡西乌斯·卡瑞亚和科尔内利乌斯·萨比努斯。罗马位于今意大利境内。

en.s: The siege of Enna or Castrogiovanni was launched by the Aghlabids against the important Byzantine city of Enna in 859. The Aghlabid forces managed to capture the city.

zh.s: 859年，阿格拉布王朝军队围攻拜占庭的重要城市恩纳（又称卡斯特罗乔瓦尼），最终攻占该城。

en.s: The first Fatimid invasion of Egypt occurred in 914–915, soon after the establishment of the Fatimid Caliphate in Ifriqiya in 909. The Fatimids launched an expedition east, against the Abbasid Caliphate, under the Berber General Habasa ibn Yusuf. Habasa succeeded in subduing the cities on the Cyrenaican coast between Ifriqiya and Egypt, and captured Alexandria. The Fatimid heir-apparent, al-Qa'im bi-Amr Allah, then arrived to take over the campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 法蒂玛王朝入侵埃及（914—915年）
zh.s: 法蒂玛王朝第一次入侵埃及发生于914至915年，当时法蒂玛哈里发国刚于909年在伊夫起亚建立不久。法蒂玛军队在柏柏尔将领哈巴萨·伊本·优素福率领下向东进军，攻打阿拔斯哈里发国。哈巴萨攻占了伊夫起亚与埃及之间昔兰尼加沿海的几座城市，并拿下亚历山大港。随后，法蒂玛王朝的继承人卡伊姆·比阿姆里·阿拉抵达，接手这场战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The siege of Aleppo was a major military engagement during the Mongol invasions of the Levant, lasting from 18 January to 24 January 1260. The Mongol army under Hulagu Khan, supported by forces from the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia and the Principality of Antioch, besieged the Ayyubid-held city after crossing the Euphrates and capturing nearby settlements.

zh.s: 阿勒颇围城战是蒙古人入侵黎凡特期间的一场重大战事，于1260年1月18日至24日进行。旭烈兀率领的蒙古军队在亚美尼亚西里西亚王国和安条克公国军队支援下，渡过幼发拉底河并攻占附近城镇，随后围攻由阿尤布王朝控制的阿勒颇。

en.s: The Battle of Arbroath was fought on Sunday, 24 January 1446 at Arbroath in Scotland between rival claimants to the post of Baillie of the Regality.

zh.s: 1446年1月24日星期日，苏格兰阿布罗斯爆发战斗，交战双方争夺当地领地司法行政官职位。

en.t: Matthias Corvinus elected king of Hungary
en.s: On 24 January 1458, the Hungarian Diet proclaimed the fourteen-year-old Matthias Corvinus king. His uncle was elected regent, although Matthias soon took effective control of government.

zh.t: 马加什·科尔维努斯当选匈牙利国王
zh.s: 1458年1月24日，匈牙利议会推举14岁的马加什·科尔维努斯为国王，并选出他的舅父担任摄政。不过，马加什很快便实际掌握了政权。

en.s: The Battle of Zasław (Polish: Bitwa pod Zasławem) took place near the village of Iziaslav, on 24 January 1491, during the Polish–Ottoman War. It was fought by the armies of the Crown of the Kingdom of Poland led by Mikołaj Chodecki, and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, led by Semyon Olshanski, against the forces of the Crimean Khanate. It was won by the Polish and Lithuanian sides.

zh.s: 扎斯瓦夫战役（波兰语：Bitwa pod Zasławem）于1491年1月24日在今天乌克兰伊贾斯拉夫附近爆发，是波兰—奥斯曼战争的一部分。参战双方是尼古拉·霍代茨基率领的波兰王国军队、谢苗·奥尔尚斯基率领的立陶宛大公国军队，以及克里米亚汗国军队。波兰和立陶宛一方获胜。

en.t: Henry VIII injured in a jousting accident
en.s: On 24 January 1536, King Henry VIII of England was injured in a jousting accident. The accident reopened and worsened an earlier leg wound, which proved difficult to treat. Claims about its effects on his later behavior are historical interpretations, not a confirmed diagnosis.

zh.t: 亨利八世在马上长矛比武中受伤
zh.s: 1536年1月24日，英格兰国王亨利八世在马上长矛比武中受伤，使腿部的旧伤重新裂开并恶化，医生难以治疗。关于这次事故如何影响他后来性格的说法，属于历史解释，并非已确认的诊断。

en.s: The Battle of Muraki Castle (January 24, 1554) was one of the first victories of the young Oda Nobunaga in his struggle to unite the province of Owari against the powerful Imagawa Yoshimoto, whose army had invaded the eastern parts of Owari.

zh.s: 1554年1月24日，年轻的织田信长在村木砦取得早期胜利之一。当时他正为统一尾张国，与强大的今川义元对抗，后者军队已入侵尾张东部。

en.s: The Battle of Byczyna or Battle of Pitschen (German: Pitschen; Polish: Byczyna) was the deciding battle of the 1587–1588 War of the Polish Succession, which erupted after two rival candidates were elected to the Polish throne. Both sides had rough parity in forces, with armies about 6,000 strong, divided roughly into half infantry and half cavalry. The battle was an overwhelming victory of the Polish-Swedish faction, led by the Swedish-born king-elect Sigismund III Vasa, over the army of his rival to the throne, Maximilian III, Archduke of Austria.

zh.s: 贝奇纳战役，也称皮岑战役，是1587—1588年波兰王位继承战争的决定性战斗。这场战争因两名竞争者同时被选为波兰国王而爆发。双方兵力大致相当，各约6,000人，步兵与骑兵大体各半。瑞典出生的候任国王齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨领导的波兰—瑞典派，大胜其王位竞争者、奥地利大公马克西米连三世的军队。战场位于今波兰贝奇纳。

en.s: The War of the Polish Succession or the Habsburg–Polish War took place from 1587 to 1588 over the election of the successor to the King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania Stephen Báthory. The war was fought between factions of Sigismund III Vasa and Maximilian III, with Sigismund eventually being crowned.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 波兰王位继承战争，也称哈布斯堡—波兰战争，于1587年至1588年间爆发，争夺波兰国王兼立陶宛大公斯特凡·巴托里去世后的继承人选。交战双方分别支持齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨和马克西米连三世，最终齐格蒙特加冕为王。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Turnhout was a military engagement which took place on 24 January 1597 in the border area between the Northern and Southern Netherlands at Turnhout during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604). Though the town had not been walled, Turnhout was an important strategic town. On 24 January 1597 on the Tielenheide (this battle is also called 'The battle on Tielenheide') in a neighbouring village (Tielen), Dutch cavalry under command of Prince Maurice met and defeated a Spanish cavalry detachment under Varax.

zh.s: 1597年1月24日，八十年战争及1585—1604年英西战争期间，北部与南部尼德兰边界的蒂伦豪特发生战斗。该镇虽无城墙，却有重要战略地位。莫里斯亲王率领荷兰骑兵，在邻村蒂伦的蒂伦荒原，与瓦拉克斯的西班牙骑兵分队相遇并将其击败。因此此战也称蒂伦荒原战役。

en.s: In the history of colonial Chile, the Parliament of Boroa (Spanish: Parlamento de Boroa) was a diplomatic meeting held on January 24, 1651, between various Mapuche groups and Spanish authorities held in the fields of Boroa. The parliament was attended by the Governor of Chile, Antonio Acuña Cabrera, who travelled to Boroa incognito from the fortress of Nacimiento in the north accompanied only by six men.

zh.s: 在智利殖民史上，博罗阿议会（西班牙语：Parlamento de Boroa）是1651年1月24日举行的一次外交会议，马普切各部族代表与西班牙官员在博罗阿原野会面。智利总督安东尼奥·阿库尼亚·卡布雷拉也出席会议。他从北面的纳西门托堡乔装出发，只带了6名随从前往博罗阿。

en.t: King Charles II of England dissolves the Cavalier Parliament
en.s: The Cavalier Parliament of England lasted from 8 May 1661 until 24 January 1679. It is the second longest-lasting English Parliament, behind the Long Parliament, and sat longer than any Great British or UK Parliament to date, enduring for nearly 18 years of the quarter-century reign of Charles II of England.

zh.t: 英格兰国王查理二世解散骑士议会
zh.s: 英格兰骑士议会从1661年5月8日延续至1679年1月24日，是英格兰历史上延续时间第二长的议会，仅次于长期议会。它的存续时间也超过迄今为止的任何大不列颠或英国议会，在查理二世长达四分之一世纪的统治期间持续了近18年。

en.s: The Raid on York (also known as the Candlemas Massacre) took place on 24 January 1692 during King William's War, when Chief Madockawando and Father Louis-Pierre Thury led 200-300 natives into the town of York (then in the District of Maine and part of the Province of Massachusetts Bay, now in the state of Maine), killing about 100 of the English settlers and burning down buildings, taking another estimated 80 villagers hostage.

zh.s: 约克突袭又称圣烛节大屠杀，于1692年1月24日在威廉王战争期间发生。首领马多卡旺多和路易-皮埃尔·蒂里神父率领200至300名原住民进入约克镇。当时该镇属于马萨诸塞湾省缅因区，现位于美国缅因州。他们杀死约100名英国殖民者，焚毁建筑，并挟持约80名村民。

en.s: The imperial election of 1742 was an imperial election held to select the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire. It took place in Frankfurt on 24 January. The result was the election of Charles Albert of Bavaria, the first non-Habsburg emperor in three hundred years.

zh.s: 1742年1月24日，神圣罗马帝国在法兰克福举行皇帝选举。选举结果是巴伐利亚的查理·阿尔伯特当选，他是300年来首位非哈布斯堡王朝的皇帝。

en.t: Accession of Charles VII, Holy Roman Emperor
en.s: Charles VII (6 August 1697 – 20 January 1745) was elector of Bavaria from 26 February 1726 and Holy Roman Emperor from 24 January 1742 to his death on 20 January 1745. He was also King of Bohemia (as Charles Albert) from 1741 to 1743.

zh.t: 查理七世即位为神圣罗马帝国皇帝
zh.s: 查理七世（1697年8月6日—1745年1月20日）自1726年2月26日起担任巴伐利亚选帝侯，并于1742年1月24日至1745年1月20日去世前担任神圣罗马帝国皇帝。他还曾于1741年至1743年以查理·阿尔伯特之名担任波希米亚国王。

en.s: The Dagohoy rebellion, also known as the Dagohoy revolution and the Dagohoy revolt, is considered as the longest rebellion in Philippine history. Led by Francisco Dagohoy, or Francisco Sendrijas, the rebellion took place on the island of Bohol from 1744 to 1829, lasting for roughly 85 years. It was one of two significant revolts that occurred in Bohol during the Spanish era.

zh.s: 达戈霍伊起义又称达戈霍伊革命或达戈霍伊叛乱，被认为是菲律宾历史上持续时间最长的起义。起义由弗朗西斯科·达戈霍伊（又名弗朗西斯科·森德里亚斯）领导，于1744年至1829年在保和岛发生，持续约85年。这是西班牙殖民时期保和岛两场重大起义之一。

en.s: The Battle of Bobbili, comprising the attack on the fort of Bobbili on 24 January 1757, was a significant event in the princely state of Vizianagaram (present day Vizianagaram district of Andhra Pradesh). Gen. Tandra Paparayudu gained the sobriquet The Tiger of Bobbili for his fierce, ultimately hopeless resistance, and final vengeance.

zh.s: 博比利战役包括1757年1月24日对博比利堡垒的进攻，是维济阿纳加拉土邦历史上的一件重大事件。坦德拉·帕帕拉尤杜将军因英勇抵抗、最终寡不敌众并为牺牲者复仇，被称为“博比利之虎”。

en.t: 1797 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1797 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 24, 1797, by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate. Incumbent Senator Aaron Burr's name was not placed into nomination for a second term. Former Senator Philip Schuyler was elected.

zh.t: 1797年美国纽约州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1797年1月24日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，改选该州第一组席位。现任参议员阿龙·伯尔未被提名竞选第二任期，前参议员菲利普·斯凯勒当选。

en.s: The Gatton by-election, 1803 was a by-election to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom that took place on 24 January 1803. The parliamentary borough of Gatton was a notorious "rotten" or pocket borough "in the pocket" of the Lord of the Manor of Gatton, who at that time was Sir Mark Wood. It had, at most, seven voters - all tenants of Wood. At the 1802 general election, "Wood returned himself and his brother-in-law (James) Dashwood". Both were members of William Pitt the Younger's faction of the Tory Party.

zh.s: 1803年1月24日，英国下议院加顿选区举行补选。加顿是著名的“腐败选区”或“口袋选区”，掌握在当时的庄园领主马克·伍德爵士手中。选民最多只有七人，全都是伍德的佃户。1802年大选中，伍德让自己与其连襟詹姆斯·达什伍德当选，两人都属于托利党内小威廉·皮特的派系。

en.s: At the Battle of Altafulla (24 January 1812), a Spanish division led by Joaquín Ibáñez Cuevas y de Valonga, Baron de Eroles clashed with an Imperial French division under the command of David-Maurice-Joseph Mathieu de La Redorte. Believing he faced only a single battalion, Eroles attacked in a heavy fog and was beaten by 8,000 French soldiers. The action occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. The battle was fought near Altafulla, 10 kilometres (6.2 mi) northeast of Tarragona, Spain.

zh.s: 1812年1月24日，埃罗莱斯男爵华金·伊瓦涅斯·奎瓦斯-德·巴隆加，率领西班牙一个师，与戴维-莫里斯-约瑟夫·马蒂厄·德拉雷多尔特指挥的法国帝国军一个师交战。埃罗莱斯误以为面前只有一个营，在浓雾中发动攻击，却被8,000名法军击败。战场在西班牙塔拉戈纳东北十公里的阿尔塔富利亚附近，是拿破仑战争中半岛战争的一部分。

en.s: The First Battle of Bar-sur-Aube (24 January 1814) was fought during the War of the Sixth Coalition when Marshal Édouard Mortier, duc de Trévise's corps of French Imperial Guards defended against an Austrians corps under Ignaz Gyulai and a Württemberger corps led by Crown Prince Frederick William of Württemberg. After holding his main defensive positions in stiff fighting, Mortier withdrew his elite troops during the night and retreated to Troyes. Bar-sur-Aube is located 53 kilometres (33 mi) east of Troyes. The 1814 Campaign opened with an invasion of eastern France by the main Coalition army led by Austrian Field Marshal Karl Philipp, Prince of Schwarzenberg and a second army led by Prussian Field Marshal Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher.

zh.t: 第一次奥布河畔巴尔战役
zh.s: 1814年1月24日，第六次反法同盟战争期间，特雷维索公爵爱德华·莫蒂埃元帅率领的法国帝国近卫军军团，抵挡伊格纳茨·久洛伊的奥地利军团，以及符腾堡王储腓特烈·威廉的符腾堡军团。莫蒂埃经过激战守住主要阵地，夜间则带精锐撤往特鲁瓦。奥布河畔巴尔在特鲁瓦以东53公里。1814年战役始于同盟军入侵法国东部，主力由奥地利施瓦岑贝格亲王卡尔·菲利普元帅率领，另一路由普鲁士格布哈德·莱贝雷希特·冯·布吕歇尔元帅率领。

en.s: In the Spanish American Wars of Independence, the action of Picheuta was a military engagement that took place on January 24, 1817, during the Crossing of the Andes. The column led by Juan Gregorio de las Heras was still crossing the mountain range, being 50 kilometers away from the Uspallata Pass.

zh.s: 皮切乌塔战斗发生于1817年1月24日，是西属美洲独立战争期间安第斯山脉跨越行动的一部分。胡安·格雷戈里奥·德拉埃拉斯率领的纵队仍在翻越山脉，距离乌斯帕亚塔山口还有50公里。

en.s: The First Battle of Mora was part of the Taos Revolt of the Mexican–American War, between United States Army troops under Captain Israel R. Hendley, versus a militia of Hispanos (acting as Mexican nationals) and Puebloan allies in US-occupied northern New Mexico. The short skirmish took place on January 24, 1847, in and around the village of Mora, resulting in a US Army defeat and the death of Hendley and several of his men.

zh.s: 1847年1月24日，美墨战争陶斯起义期间，以色列·R.亨德利上尉率美国陆军，与以墨西哥国民身份抵抗的西班牙裔民兵及普韦布洛盟友，在美军占领的新墨西哥北部莫拉村及周边交战。短暂冲突最终美军战败，亨德利及数名部下阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Cañada was a popular insurrection against the American occupation of New Mexico by Mexicans and Pueblo Indians. It took place on January 24, 1847, during the Taos Revolt, a conflict of the Mexican–American War.

zh.s: 卡尼亚达战役是墨西哥人和普韦布洛原住民反抗美国占领新墨西哥的一场起义，发生于1847年1月24日，是美墨战争期间陶斯起义的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Sabana Larga (Spanish: Batalla de Sabana Larga) was a major battle during the years after the Dominican War of Independence. It was fought on 24 January 1856 in Sabana Larga, Dajabón. A force of 8,000 Dominican troops of the Army of the North, led by General Juan Luis Franco Bidó, defeated a numerically larger force of 22,000 Haitian troops under Emperor Faustin I.

zh.s: 萨瓦纳拉尔加战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Sabana Larga）是多米尼加独立战争结束后几年间的一场重大战役，于1856年1月24日在达哈翁省萨瓦纳拉尔加交战。胡安·路易斯·弗兰科·比多将军率领8000名多米尼加北方军击败了法斯丁一世皇帝指挥的海地军队，对方人数更多，共有2.2万人。

en.t: The University of Calcutta is formally founded as the first fully fledged university in South Asia
en.s: The University of Calcutta, informally known as Calcutta University (CU), is a public state research university located in Kolkata, also known as Calcutta, in West Bengal, India. It has 151 affiliated undergraduate colleges and 16 institutes in Kolkata and nearby areas. It was established on 24 January 1857 and is the oldest multidisciplinary university of the Indian Subcontinent and the Southeast Asian Region.

zh.t: 加尔各答大学正式成立，成为南亚第一所完整建制的大学
zh.s: 加尔各答大学是一所位于印度西孟加拉邦加尔各答（旧称Calcutta）的公立邦立研究型大学，俗称加尔各答大学（CU）。该校有151所附属本科院校，以及位于加尔各答及周边地区的16所研究机构。学校于1857年1月24日成立，是印度次大陆和东南亚地区最古老的综合性大学。

en.s: The Zungwini Mountain skirmishes took place on 20, 22 and 24 January 1879 during the Anglo-Zulu War. The mountain was a stronghold of the AbaQulusi Zulu tribe, who were reinforced by the forces of exiled Swazi prince Mbilini waMswati. The mountain lay near the proposed route of advance of a British column under Lieutenant-Colonel Evelyn Wood, one of three that marched on the Zulu capital, Ulundi, from early January.

zh.s: 祖鲁战争期间，双方于1879年1月20日、22日和24日在宗格温尼山发生冲突。该山是阿巴夸鲁西祖鲁人的据点，流亡的斯威士兰王子姆比利尼·瓦姆斯瓦蒂率军前来增援。英国军队计划从该山附近推进。1月初，埃夫琳·伍德中校率领的一支英军纵队已向祖鲁首都乌伦迪进发，三支纵队均以此为目标。

en.s: The Italo-Ethiopian War of 1887–1889 was an undeclared war between the Kingdom of Italy and the Ethiopian Empire occurring during the Italian colonization of Eritrea, then a province of the Ethiopian Empire under the name of Mereb Melash. The conflict ended with the treaty of Wuchale, which delimited the border between Ethiopia and Italian Eritrea. The treaty also contained clauses whose different interpretations led to another Italo-Ethiopian War.

zh.s: 1887年至1889年的意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争是意大利王国与埃塞俄比亚帝国之间的一场未宣战冲突，发生在意大利殖民厄立特里亚期间。当时厄立特里亚是埃塞俄比亚帝国的一个省，名为梅雷布·梅拉什。战争以《乌恰利条约》结束，条约划定了埃塞俄比亚与意属厄立特里亚的边界。但条约条款的不同解读，后来又引发了另一场意埃战争。

zh.s: 塔拉克起义（菲律宾语：Sigaw sa Tarlac；西班牙语：Gritos de Tarlac）是1897年1月由弗朗西斯科·马卡布洛斯将军领导的一场起义，发生在塔拉克省拉巴斯。起义发生前，塔拉克省已被列为叛乱地区；起义爆发后，主要战事随之展开。

en.s: The Battle of Dogger Bank (24 January 1915) was a naval engagement during the First World War near the Dogger Bank in the North Sea, between squadrons of the British Grand Fleet and the Kaiserliche Marine (High Seas Fleet). The British had intercepted and decoded German wireless transmissions, gaining advance knowledge that a German raiding squadron was heading for the Dogger Bank.

zh.s: 多格滩海战于1915年1月24日在第一次世界大战期间爆发，战场位于北海多格滩附近。交战双方是英国大舰队和德国公海舰队。英国截获并破译了德国无线电通信，提前获知一支德国袭击舰队正驶向多格滩。

en.s: The Battle of Jarrab was a territorial battle between the Al Saud and their traditional enemies, the Al Rashid on 24 January 1915. It was a proxy battle of World War I and the Second Saud-Rashidi War between the British-supported Saudis and the Ottoman-supported Rashidis. Rashidi forces led by young Saud bin Abdulaziz Al Rashid defeated the forces of Ibn Saud.

zh.s: 1915年1月24日，沙特家族与传统对手拉希德家族在贾拉卜交战。这场争夺领土的战役既是第一次世界大战的代理冲突，也是第二次沙特—拉希德战争的一部分。英国支持沙特一方，奥斯曼帝国支持拉希德一方。年轻的沙特·本·阿卜杜勒-阿齐兹·阿勒拉希德率领的拉希德军队击败了伊本·沙特的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Rafajlowa took place in the night of January 23–24, 1915, during World War I. The 2nd Brigade, Polish Legions, which was part of the Austro-Hungarian Army repelled a night raid of the Russian Imperial Army, which was aimed at blocking all passes through Gorgany mountain range in Eastern Carpathians. The battle took place in the village of Rafajlowa, Austrian Galicia (now the village is called Bystrytsia, and belongs to Ukraine).

zh.s: 拉法伊洛瓦战役发生于1915年1月23日至24日夜间，是第一次世界大战中的一场战斗。奥匈帝国军队所属的波兰军团第2旅击退了俄罗斯帝国军队的夜袭。俄军试图封锁东喀尔巴阡山脉戈尔加尼山脉的所有山口。战斗地点是奥属加利西亚的拉法伊洛瓦村，今名比斯特里察，位于乌克兰。

en.t: Brushaber v. Union Pacific Railroad Co.
en.s: Brushaber v. Union Pacific Railroad Co., 240 U.S. 1 (1916), was a landmark United States Supreme Court case in which the Court upheld the validity of a tax statute called the Revenue Act of 1913, also known as the Tariff Act, Ch. 16, 38 Stat. 166 (October 3, 1913), enacted pursuant to Article I, section 8, clause 1 of, and the Sixteenth Amendment to, the United States Constitution, which did not confer any new powers of taxation.

zh.t: 布拉舍伯诉联合太平洋铁路公司案
zh.s: 布拉舍伯诉联合太平洋铁路公司案（240 U.S. 1，1916年）是美国联邦最高法院的一项里程碑判决。法院在该案中维持了一项税法的效力，即1913年《收入法》（又称《关税法》，第16章，38 Stat. 166），该法依据美国宪法第一条第八款第一项和第十六修正案制定；这些规定并未赋予联邦政府新的征税权。

en.s: The capture of Wejh (modern-day Al Wajh, Saudi Arabia) took place on 23–24 January 1917 when British-led Arab forces landed by sea and, with the support of naval bombardments, defeated the Ottoman garrison. The attack was intended to threaten the flanks of an Ottoman advance from their garrison in Medina to Mecca, which had been captured by Arab forces in 1916.

zh.s: 英国领导的阿拉伯军队于1917年1月23日至24日从海上登陆，并在海军炮击支援下击败奥斯曼守军，攻占韦杰（今沙特阿拉伯瓦吉赫）。这次行动意在威胁奥斯曼军队的侧翼；奥军正从麦地那驻军向麦加推进，而麦加已于1916年被阿拉伯军队攻占。

en.s: The Irish general election of 1933 was held on 24 January 1933. The newly elected members of the 8th Dáil assembled at Leinster House on 8 February when the new President of the Executive Council and Executive Council of the Irish Free State were appointed. Fianna Fáil retained power, though fell one seat short of an overall majority. The general election took place in 30 parliamentary constituencies throughout the Irish Free State for 153 seats in the lower house of parliament, Dáil Éireann.

zh.s: 1933年1月24日，爱尔兰自由邦在30个选区举行大选，改选下议院153席。共和党继续执政，但距离绝对多数差一席。新当选的第八届议会议员于2月8日在伦斯特府集会，任命新一届行政委员会主席及行政委员会。

en.s: The first battle of Tembien was fought on the northern front of what was known as the Second Italo-Ethiopian War. This battle consisted of attacks and counterattacks by Italian forces under Marshal Pietro Badoglio and Ethiopian forces under Ras Kassa Haile Darge. This battle was primarily fought around Worsege Pass (Italian: Passo Uarieu also translated as the Warieu Pass) in what was then the Tembien Province of Ethiopia.

zh.s: 第一次滕比恩战役发生在第二次意大利—埃塞俄比亚战争北线。皮埃特罗·巴多格里奥元帅率领的意大利军队与卡萨·海尔·达尔杰率领的埃塞俄比亚军队互相进攻和反击。战斗主要围绕当时埃塞俄比亚滕比恩省的沃尔塞格山口（意大利语：Passo Uarieu，也译作瓦里厄山口）展开。

zh.s: 1936年1月24日，阿尔贝·萨罗第二次出任法国总理。他的第二届内阁持续至同年6月4日。

en.s: The 1939 Chillán earthquake occurred in south-central Chile on 24 January with a surface-wave magnitude of 8.3 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). With a death toll of around 28,000, compared to the 2,231–6,000 (official estimates vary greatly) of the Great Chilean earthquake of 1960, it is the single deadliest earthquake in Chile.

zh.s: 1939年奇廉地震于1月24日发生在智利中南部，面波震级为8.3级，最高烈度达麦加利烈度X级（极强）。此次地震约造成2.8万人死亡；相比之下，1960年智利大地震的官方死亡人数估计差异很大，为2,231至6,000人。这是智利历史上死亡人数最多的地震。

en.s: The action at Mechili was an engagement between units of the British 7th Armoured Division of the Western Desert Force and Italian forces of the 10th Army during Operation Compass. The Italian Army redeemed itself from the campaign's previous disastrous fiascoes. The previous British advantages in reconnaissance, maneuver, and artillery support were greatly reduced due to the British supply shortages in fuel and artillery ammunition, the battle field was now hilly and broken terrain, and they had not yet set up forward air fields.

zh.s: 梅奇利战斗是“指南针行动”期间的一场交战，参战方是西部沙漠部队中的英国第7装甲师和意大利第10集团军。此前战役中意军屡遭惨败，这次有所扳回。英国军队原本在侦察、机动和炮兵支援方面占优势，但燃料和炮弹短缺削弱了这些优势；战场地势多丘陵、崎岖不平，英军也尚未建立前沿机场。

en.s: The Battle of Kendari took place on 24 January 1942 as part of the Japanese offensive in the Dutch East Indies. The airfield Kendari II at Kendari became an essential target for Japanese forces for its strategic location and infrastructure quality. Encountering little to no resistance, Japanese troops managed to capture the airfield in one day, as the Dutch defenders were already in retreat inland.

zh.s: 肯达里战役于1942年1月24日爆发，是日本进攻荷属东印度群岛的一部分。肯达里二号机场因地理位置和基础设施条件优越，成为日军的重要目标。日军几乎没有遇到抵抗，一天之内就攻占机场；荷兰守军当时已向内陆撤退。

en.s: Operation Cartoon was a British Commando raid on the island of Stord near Leirvik in Hordaland, Norway over the night of the 23rd and 24 January 1943. The operation was carried out by fifty-three men of No. 12 Commando supported by ten men from the Norwegian 10 (IA) Commando under the command of Captain Harald Risnes (1914-1967).

zh.s: 1943年1月23日至24日夜间，英国突击队在挪威霍达兰郡莱尔维克附近的斯图尔岛发动突袭，代号“漫画”。行动由第12突击队53人实施，另有第10跨盟国突击队的十名挪威队员支援，由哈拉尔·里斯内斯上尉指挥。里斯内斯生于1914年，卒于1967年。

en.s: The New Orleans mayoral election of 1950 was held on January 24, 1950. It resulted in the re-election of deLesseps Morrison to his second term as Mayor of New Orleans. Like most Southern states between Reconstruction and the civil rights era, Louisiana's Republican Party was virtually nonexistent in terms of electoral support. This meant that the city's Democratic primary was the real contest for mayor. Incumbent mayor deLesseps Morrison was backed by labor unions, the major newspapers, and black New Orleanians, but he also publicly maintained his support for segregation on the campaign trail.

zh.s: 1950年1月24日，新奥尔良举行市长选举，德莱塞普斯·莫里森连任第二个任期。与重建时期至民权运动年代之间多数南方州一样，路易斯安那共和党几乎没有选举支持，因此市民主党初选才是真正决定市长人选的角逐。莫里森得到工会、主要报纸及新奥尔良黑人支持，但在竞选中仍公开支持种族隔离。

en.s: The 1961 Goldsboro B-52 crash was an accident that occurred in Goldsboro, North Carolina, on January 24, 1961. A B-52 Stratofortress carrying two Mark 39 nuclear bombs broke up in mid-air, dropping its nuclear payload in the process. The pilot in command ordered the crew to eject at 9,000 feet (2,700 m). Five men successfully ejected or bailed out of the aircraft and landed safely. Another ejected but did not survive the landing, and two died in the crash. Information newly declassified in 2013 showed that one of the bombs came very close to detonating.

zh.s: 1961年1月24日，美国北卡罗来纳州戈尔兹伯勒，一架携带两枚Mk 39核弹的B-52“同温层堡垒”轰炸机在空中解体，核弹随之掉落。机长在9,000英尺、即2,700米高度下令弃机。五人成功弹射或跳伞并安全落地，另有一人弹射后着陆时死亡，两人死于坠机。2013年新解密的信息显示，其中一枚核弹曾极接近引爆。

en.s: Air India Flight 101 was a scheduled Air India passenger flight from Bombay to London that accidentally flew into Mont Blanc in France on the morning of 24 January 1966. The accident was caused by a misunderstood verbal instruction from the radar controller to the pilot in lieu of VOR data, one of the receivers being out of service.

zh.s: 1966年1月24日上午，印度航空101号定期客运航班，从孟买飞往伦敦途中，意外撞上法国勃朗峰。由于机上一台甚高频全向信标接收器失灵，雷达管制员改以口头指令向飞行员提供信息，但指令被误解，导致事故。

en.s: The Battle of Ban Houei Sane took place during the Vietnam War, beginning on the night of 23 January 1968, when the 24th Regiment of the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) 304th Division overran the small Royal Lao Army outpost at Ban Houei Sane. The fighting at Ban Houei Sane was one in a series of battles fought between North Vietnamese and Allied forces during the Tet Offensive.

zh.s: 班惠桑战役发生于越南战争期间。1968年1月23日夜间，越南人民军第304师第24团攻占了班惠桑的老挝王国军小型前哨。班惠桑的战斗是北越军与盟军在春节攻势期间进行的一系列战役之一。

zh.s: 科堡行动（1968年1月24日至3月1日）是越南战争期间澳大利亚和新西兰军队开展的一次军事行动。行动中，澳大利亚第1特遣部队与北越人民军和越共部队在隆平和边和一带的更大规模战斗中多次激战。

en.s: The 1972 Iowa Democratic presidential caucuses were held on January 24, 1972, as the first step in determining the Democratic nominee for the 1972 election. zh.s: 1972年1月24日，民主党在艾奥瓦州举行总统候选人党团会议，是确定当年总统候选人的第一步。缅因州参议员埃德蒙·马斯基取得最多的明确支持票，占35.5%；多数民调中原本落后的南达科他州参议员乔治·麦戈文，则以22.6%意外居第二。

en.s: On 24 January 1972, two local men found Japanese soldier Shoichi Yokoi near Talofofo in Guam. He had remained in hiding almost twenty-eight years after US forces regained control of the island in 1944.

zh.t: 横井庄一在关岛被发现
zh.s: 1972年1月24日，两名当地男子在关岛塔洛福福附近发现日本士兵横井庄一。自1944年美军重新控制关岛后，他已在当地躲藏近28年。

en.s: The first indirect presidential election was held on 24 January 1974. This was the first and last presidential election under a parliamentary system before the presidential system was introduced in January 1975. Mohammad Mohammadullah was elected as the president by the National Assembly without any voting since there were no other candidates. Mohammad Mohammadullah was sworn in at Bangabhaban on 27 January 1974.

zh.s: 1974年1月24日，孟加拉国举行首次间接总统选举。这是在1975年1月引入总统制之前，议会制下第一次也是最后一次总统选举。穆罕默德·穆罕默杜拉因没有其他候选人，由国民议会直接选出，无须投票。他于1月27日在总统府宣誓就职。

en.s: The 1977 Massacre of Atocha, a part of neofascist terrorism in Spain, was an attack during the Spanish transition to democracy after the death of Franco in 1975, killing five and injuring four. It was committed on January 24, 1977, in an office located on 55 Atocha Street near the Atocha railway station in Madrid, where specialists in labour law, members of the Workers' Commissions trade union (CCOO), and of the then-clandestine Communist Party of Spain (PCE), had gathered. The next day, the massacre was defended by a group calling itself Alianza Apostólica Anticomunista (literally The Apostolic Anticommunist Alliance, abbreviated Triple A or AAA).

zh.s: 1977年1月24日，西班牙马德里阿托查火车站附近、阿托查街55号的一间办公室发生新法西斯恐怖袭击，造成五人死亡、四人受伤。当时，劳动法律师、工人委员会工会成员，以及仍处地下状态的西班牙共产党成员在此聚集。事件发生在佛朗哥1975年去世后的民主转型时期。次日，一个自称“使徒反共联盟”，简称AAA的组织，为这场屠杀辩护。

en.s: Bunkhouse Stampede 1988 was the third professional wrestling Bunkhouse Stampede event produced by Jim Crockett Promotions (JCP) under the National Wrestling Alliance (NWA) banner and it was the only Bunkhouse Stampede event to air as a pay-per-view (PPV) event. The event took place on January 24, 1988 from the Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum in Uniondale, New York. The main event was a Steel Cage Bunkhouse Stampede, which was won by Dusty Rhodes. The undercard featured Ric Flair versus Road Warrior Hawk for the NWA World Heavyweight Championship, Barry Windham versus Larry Zbyzsko for the NWA Western States Heritage Championship and Nikita Koloff versus Bobby Eaton for the NWA World Television Championship.

zh.s: 1988年1月24日，吉姆·克罗克特推广公司以全国摔角联盟（NWA）名义，在美国纽约州联合谷的拿骚退伍军人纪念体育馆，举办第三届“工棚混战”，也是唯一采用按次付费形式的一届。压轴钢笼工棚混战由达斯蒂·罗兹获胜。其他比赛包括里克·弗莱尔对阵Road Warrior Hawk，争夺NWA世界重量级冠军；巴里·温德姆对阵拉里·兹比什科，争夺西部各州传统冠军；尼基塔·科洛夫对阵博比·伊顿，争夺NWA世界电视冠军。

en.s: The 1988 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling television special produced by the American promotion World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the inaugural Royal Rumble event and took place on January 24, 1988, at the Copps Coliseum in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. The event aired live on the USA Network on the same night as Jim Crockett Promotions's Bunkhouse Stampede pay-per-view (PPV) event.

en.s: On January 24, 1988, an Aeroflot Yak-40 crashed after takeoff near Nizhnevartovsk Airport, in present-day Russia. Twenty-seven of the thirty-one people on board died, and four passengers survived. The exact cause of the loss of engine power was not established with certainty.

zh.t: 苏联民航雅克-40客机在下瓦尔托夫斯克附近坠毁

en.s: The 1989 Attack on La Tablada barracks also known as the Battle of La Tablada occurred on 23 and 24 January 1989 when 40 members of Movimiento Todos por la Patria (MTP) attacked the military barracks in La Tablada, in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. 39 people were killed and 60 injured by the time the Argentine army retook the barracks.

zh.t: 1989年阿根廷拉塔布拉达军营遇袭

en.s: The attack on Ras Tanura was an attempted aerial bombing of the Ras Tanura oil production facility in Saudi Arabia during the Gulf War. Employing Dassault Mirage F1 fighters loaded with incendiary bombs, and two Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23s as fighter cover, Iraq intended to demonstrate to the coalition that it was capable of offensive air actions.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Mauritania on 24 January 1992. They followed the constitutional referendum the previous year that resulted in the reintroduction of multi-party democracy, and were the first presidential elections to feature more than one candidate. The result was a victory for incumbent President Maaouya Ould Sid'Ahmed Taya of the Democratic and Social Republican Party, who defeated three other candidates with 62.7% of the vote.

zh.s: 1992年1月24日，毛里塔尼亚举行总统选举。前一年宪法公投恢复多党民主，因此这成为首次有多名候选人参选的总统选举。民主社会共和党的现任总统马奥维亚·乌尔德·西德·艾哈迈德·塔亚，以62.7%的得票率击败另外三名候选人。

en.s: The 1993 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE). It was the sixth annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 24, 1993, at the ARCO Arena in Sacramento, California. It centered on the men's Royal Rumble match, a modified 30-man battle royal in which the participants enter at timed intervals instead of all beginning in the ring at the same time.

en.s: Royal Rumble (1999) was the twelfth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on January 24, 1999, at the Arrowhead Pond of Anaheim in Anaheim, California. The title of the event was taken from a promise by Mr. McMahon that the first entrant in the Royal Rumble, Stone Cold Steve Austin, had "no chance in hell" of winning the match. The theme song for the event, based on the phrase, would go on to become the entrance music for McMahon's stable The Corporation and later, just McMahon himself, which he uses to this day.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Croatia on 24 January 2000. They were the third presidential elections since independence in 1991, and were also the first early presidential elections, as they were held due to the death of incumbent president Franjo Tuđman on 10 December 1999. As no candidate passed the 50% threshold, a second round was held on 7 February, the first time a second round had been required in the country's history. The result was a victory for Stjepan Mesić of the Croatian People's Party, who received 56% of the vote. Voter turnout was 63.0% in the first round and 60.9% in the second round.

zh.s: 2000年1月24日，克罗地亚举行自1991年独立后的第三次总统选举。现任总统弗拉尼奥·图季曼于1999年12月10日去世，因此这也是首次提前总统选举。首轮无人超过50%，2月7日进行该国史上首次总统选举第二轮。克罗地亚人民党的斯捷潘·梅西奇以56%的得票率获胜。第一轮投票率为63.0%，第二轮为60.9%。

en.s: The Domodedovo International Airport bombing was a suicide bombing in the international arrival hall of Moscow Domodedovo Airport, in Domodedovsky District, Moscow Oblast, on 24 January 2011. The bombing killed 37 people and injured 173 others, including 86 who had to be hospitalised. Of the casualties, 31 died at the scene, three later in hospitals, one en route to a hospital, one on 2 February after having been put in a coma, and another on 24 February after being hospitalised in grave condition.

zh.t: 多莫杰多沃国际机场爆炸案

en.s: A Portuguese presidential election was held on 24 January 2016. This election chose the successor to the President Aníbal Cavaco Silva, who was constitutionally not allowed to run for a third consecutive term. Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa, the candidate supported by the PSD, CDS-PP and PPM, won the election on the first round with 52% of the vote. Marcelo also won in every single district in the country and only lost a few municipalities in the south of the country. Turnout was higher than that of the 2011 election, but reached a record low in a presidential election with no incumbents as only 48.66% of the electorate cast a ballot.

zh.s: 2016年1月24日，葡萄牙举行总统选举，接替受宪法限制、不能连续第三次参选的阿尼巴尔·卡瓦科·席尔瓦。得到社会民主党、人民党及人民君主党支持的马塞洛·雷贝洛·德索萨，以首轮52%的得票率获胜。他赢得全国每一个区，只在南部少数市镇落败。投票率高于2011年，但只有48.66%的选民投票，创下没有现任总统参选的总统选举中的最低纪录。

en.s: On January 24, 2021, jihadists from Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM) launched simultaneous attacks on Malian troops stationed in the towns of Boulikessi and Mondoro, Mali. The Malian forces, combined with French weapons from Operation Barkhane, repulsed the JNIM attacks from both towns.

en.s: The 2021 Israeli Labor Party leadership election was held on 24 January 2021 in the lead-up to the 2021 Israeli legislative election. The candidates were Merav Michaeli, Avi Shaked, Yitzhak Taym, Gil Beilin, Navah Katz, David Landsman, and Ofer Segman. Michaeli won the leadership election with 77.5% of the vote.

en.s: The 51st International Film Festival of India was held from 16 to 24 January 2021 in Goa. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic the festival went hybrid, there was physical and virtual screening of 50 films out of 224 films across various categories. Bangladesh was country of focus in the festival with four films of the country included in 'country of focus' section.

en.t: Andrew RT Davies returns as Welsh Conservative leader
en.s: On 24 January 2021, Conservative members of the Welsh Parliament unanimously backed Andrew RT Davies as their leader. He succeeded Paul Davies, who had resigned the previous day following a controversy over possible breaches of COVID-19 restrictions.

zh.t: 安德鲁·RT·戴维斯再次出任威尔士保守党领袖
zh.s: 2021年1月24日，威尔士议会保守党议员一致支持安德鲁·RT·戴维斯担任领袖。他接替前一天辞职的保罗·戴维斯，后者因涉嫌违反新冠防疫限制引发争议。

en.s: On January 24, 2022, voting closed in the mayoral by-election in Richmond Hill, Ontario, Canada. David West won the election. Voting had taken place from January 18 to 24, with internet voting available during the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 列治文山市长补选投票结束
zh.s: 2022年1月24日，加拿大安大略省列治文山市长补选投票结束，大卫·韦斯特当选。投票从1月18日持续到24日，新冠疫情期间也开放了网络投票。

en.t: Russian Il-76 transport crashes in Belgorod Oblast
en.s: On 24 January 2024, a Russian Air Force Il-76 transport plane crashed in Korochansky District, Belgorod Oblast, Russia. Russian authorities said that 74 people were on board, including 65 Ukrainian prisoners of war intended for an exchange.

zh.t: 俄军伊尔-76运输机在别尔哥罗德州坠毁
zh.s: 2024年1月24日，一架俄罗斯空军伊尔-76运输机在俄罗斯别尔哥罗德州科罗恰区坠毁。俄方称机上有74人，其中包括65名准备交换的乌克兰战俘。

en.s: On the early morning of January 24, 2026, heavy rains caused major landslides in West Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia. The landslide buried at least 53 homes, and killed up to 80 people, and 20 others missing.
